# KOVA

> KOVA is a free, offline workout tracker and strength log for Android, with iOS in
> development. Tap the muscle on an interactive body map, log reps and weight set by set,
> and read progress built from your own sets. No account, no ads, no subscription, and no
> INTERNET permission.

## Install

- F-Droid: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.kova.app/
- IzzyOnDroid: https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/index/apk/com.kova.app?repo=main
- OpenAPK: https://www.openapk.net/kova/com.kova.app/
- GitHub releases: https://github.com/ravvdevv/kova-app/releases
- Obtainium: for automatic in-app updates
- Package: `com.kova.app` · Android 7.0+ (supported) · iOS 15+ (in development) · Wear OS 3+ (in progress) · desktop (planned)

## Privacy

KOVA ships with no analytics, no advertising SDK and no network code. Android's
`INTERNET` permission is never requested, so there is no mechanism for training data to
leave the phone. The only outbound action in the app is a link the user taps.

Permissions requested, and why:

- `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` — the rest timer counts down in the shade
- `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` — the rest timer ends on time, not approximately
- `VIBRATE` — the alarm buzzes instead of only sounding
- `WAKE_LOCK` — the rest timer still fires with the screen off

Data ownership: export to CSV or a full ZIP backup (media included) and import it back;
import history from Hevy, Strong, Lyfta, FitNotes, openGym or any CSV; delete everything
in one tap. Photos, videos and notes stay in the app's own storage.

## Features

Training: interactive body map (front and back), session picked for a focus then edited set
by set, reps/weight/RPE, rest timer with a custom alarm sound, set types (warm-up, working,
drop set, to failure), supersets, plates per side from your own kit, a live session that
survives a reboot, routines scheduled per weekday, and "places" that only offer exercises
matching the equipment available at home, in the gym or in the park.

Progress: volume, streak, weekly goal ring, personal records, GitHub-style activity heatmap,
strength curves with estimated 1RM, 30-day muscle split, progress-photo timeline (or the same
timeline drawn as a muscle map), bodyweight plus ten body measurements, levels, 20 medals and
a share card.

Exercises and tools: 500+ exercises with animation and step-by-step instructions, search and
filters by muscle/equipment/level, favourites and custom exercises, custom photo/GIF/video art
per exercise, a training journal on a calendar, six calculators (1RM, plates, BMI, calories and
macros, body fat, warm-up) and five home-screen widgets.
